name: دانشجوی بی‌پول که با نودل فوری زندگی می‌کند
description: A Persian student surviving on instant noodles asks how to learn cheap and simple meals, and admits having no money for fancy ingredients. Verifies the school thread opens, the cheap-cooking question routes to the cooking fact, and the money constraint stays on the money thread.

turns.text: دانشجوام و با نودل فوری زنده‌ام
چطور غذاهای ارزون و ساده یاد بگیرم؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the school thread (student, instant noodles). Turn 2 answers the cheap-meals question from the cooking knowledge fact in Persian. Turn 3 keeps the budget constraint on the money thread.
expected.behavior: Student poverty is handled without shame: cheap cooking advice is practical and ingredient-light, and the no-money disclosure is acknowledged as a real constraint, not a joke.
